conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled, warmed by freezing and prior trials; no forced GC; each variant uses a new process and new DB
conditions.trials: Three warmup pairs excluded, then ten alternating AB/BA pairs per dataset unless CLI overrides; each initial build supplies the identical pre-append state for that trial
conditions.timing: Product StageProfiler refresh through COMMIT/optimize; queries outside refresh; copy, process startup, DB open/migration, empty rollup activation, append, checks and source restoration excluded
conditions.queries: All pages and total group counts, provider basis, fixed full time range, excludeEmptyUsage=true, unknownTime=include, Asia/Seoul; first post-refresh query per grouping
conditions.instrumentation: Separate structural diagnostic: baseline expansion counters and candidate queue/group wrappers; times excluded from main A/B medians
conditions.residual: relatedControlMs = expandRelated stage minus nested readSource elapsed; includes lineage, queue/search, callbacks and timer overhead; not pure graph search CPU time
conditions.exclusions: UI, IPC, quota calls, heap/GC peak and independent real-log parser oracle not measured

correctness.independentRealDataParserOracle: not performed; synthetic totals checked against generator
